summary: Complete testing of CLOCKLN subscription (SaaS plans) and reports (PDF/Excel) features. All 14 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified subscription page with 3 plan cards (Free/Pro/Business), upgrade buttons successfully redirecting to Stripe checkout, and reports page with working PDF/Excel download buttons.
passed_tests: GET /api/plans - returns 3 plans (free, pro, business) with features and pricing
GET /api/subscription/current - returns company plan (free), 3/5 employees, status: active
GET /api/subscription/current - requires HR authentication (401/403 without auth)
POST /api/subscription/checkout - blocks free plan checkout (400)
POST /api/subscription/checkout - rejects invalid plan (400)
POST /api/subscription/checkout - creates Stripe session for pro plan (returns checkout_url)
POST /api/subscription/checkout - creates Stripe session for business plan
GET /api/subscription/status/{session_id} - returns 404 for invalid session
GET /api/reports/attendance/pdf - generates PDF with correct headers (application/pdf, %PDF magic bytes)
GET /api/reports/attendance/excel - generates XLSX with correct headers (spreadsheet content-type, PK zip magic bytes)
GET /api/reports/employees/pdf - generates employee roster PDF
All report endpoints require HR authentication
Attendance reports validate required date parameters (422 on missing)
GET /api/subscription/history - returns payment transaction list
Frontend: Subscription page renders with 3 plan cards (plan-card-free, plan-card-pro, plan-card-business)
Frontend: Current plan section shows 'Free' with 3/5 employees progress bar
Frontend: 'Fazer Upgrade' buttons visible for Pro and Business plans
Frontend: Click on Pro upgrade redirects to Stripe checkout (https://checkout.stripe.com/...)
Frontend: Reports page renders with date pickers (start-date-input, end-date-input)
Frontend: Reports page shows PDF and Excel download buttons for attendance
Frontend: Reports page shows PDF download button for employee list
Frontend: HR Dashboard has 'Plano' (subscription-btn) and 'Relatórios' (reports-btn) buttons
seed_data_creation: Payment transactions created via Stripe checkout test (pro and business plans)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Subscription and Reports features fully tested. Stripe is using test key (sk_test_emergent). Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_subscription_reports.py. Company is on Free plan with 3/5 employees. Checkout creates payment_transactions in MongoDB. PDF reports use reportlab, Excel uses xlsxwriter.
stripe_integration_note: Stripe is configured with test key (sk_test_emergent). Checkout redirects to live Stripe checkout page. Payment status polling is implemented in frontend via /api/subscription/status/{session_id}.
